build_model_parallel_attention: build a ModelParallelMultiheadAttention module with specified embed_dim and num_heads for multi-GPU training
run_forward_attention: run the forward pass of ModelParallelMultiheadAttention with query, key, and value tensors
create_self_attention_layer: create a self-attention layer using ModelParallelMultiheadAttention with self_attention set to True

review_reorder_incremental_state: review the reorder_incremental_state method to understand how it reorders buffered state for beam search
